title: 先天代謝疾病與骨硬化症

blocks.en: © The Author(s) 2024 A. Sureda et al. (eds.), The EBMT Handbook, https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-44080-9_91 91Inborn Errors of Metabolism and Osteopetrosis Robert Wynn and Ansgar Schulz 91.1 Inborn Errors of Metabolism 91.1.1 Definition and Epidemiology Inborn errors of metabolism (IEM) comprise a large group of inherited diseases. They are individually rare. HCT is indicated only in a small number of diseases.
blocks.zh: 【第91章：先天代謝疾病與骨硬化症】作者：Robert Wynn、Ansgar Schulz。〔91.1 先天代謝疾病；91.1.1 定義與流行病學〕先天代謝疾病（IEM）包含大量遺傳疾病，各病均罕見；只有少部分疾病具有 HCT 適應症。

blocks.en: It can be curative in certain lysosomal disorders, peroxisomal disorders or certain disorders of mitochondrial function. This review will be limited to the commoner indications reported in HCT registries and which together account for most of transplanted IEM.
blocks.zh: HCT 可治癒某些溶小體、過氧化體或粒線體功能疾病。本章限於移植登錄庫中較常見、合計占多數 IEM 移植病例的適應症。

blocks.en: 91.1.2 Diagnosis Timely diagnosis is imperative in IEM since in all such diseases, HCT is better at preventing disease progression than reversing established disease manifestations. Indeed, HCT might be contraindicated in those patients presenting with more advanced disease.
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.2 診斷〕IEM 必須及時診斷，因為對這些疾病，HCT 預防進展的效果，優於逆轉已形成的病變。疾病較晚期者，甚至可能有 HCT 禁忌症。

blocks.en: This is true for all lysosomal storage diseases and for X-ALD.
blocks.zh: 這適用於所有 lysosomal storage diseases（溶小體儲積症）及 X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy（X-ALD）。

blocks.en: Diagnosis is made in three ways – Through early clinical recognition of disease manifestations – Through screening of pre-symptomatic individuals within a known affected kindred – Population screening for disease, such as in the neonatal period, with new-born screening In X-ALD, transplant is indicated for the pre-vention of progression of cerebral inflammation, which manifests with a high interpersonal variability, even within an affected kindred. Progress of inflammation is detected with serial cerebral MRI scans (at 6 or 12 monthly intervals) in boys, that are genetically affected but currently well.
blocks.zh: 診斷途徑有三種：① 早期辨識臨床表現；② 在已知受影響家系中篩檢尚無症狀者；③ 人口篩檢，例如新生兒篩檢。X-ALD 的移植目的，是防止腦部發炎持續進展；即使同一家族，其表現也有很大差異。因此，對基因已確認受影響、但目前仍健康的男孩，每 6 或 12 個月追蹤腦部 MRI，以偵測發炎進展。

blocks.en: 91.1.3 Classification (See Table 91.1) 91.1.4 Risk Factors Patient performance score at transplant predicts transplant outcome. Patients with an adverse performance score at transplant also have an inferior long-term survival as the transplant fails in advanced disease to prevent disease progression.
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.3 分類〕見表91.1。〔91.1.4 風險因子〕移植時的 performance score 可預測結果。功能狀態較差者，長期存活亦較差，因為對晚期疾病，移植無法阻止病程繼續進展。

blocks.en: Table 91.1 Classification of inborn errors of metabolism IEM Hurler syndrome, MPSIH Hurler syndrome. This is the most severe phenotype of iduronidase deficiency, a lysosomal storage disorder (LSD), which results in the accumulation of glycosaminoglycans, heparan and dermatan sulfate. There is progressive multiorgan dysfunction including psychomotor retardation, severe skeletal disease, life-threatening cardiopulmonary complications, and premature death, HCT prevents early death and attenuates the multisystem disease manifestations as the deficient enzyme is donated by engrafted donor leucocytes to host tissues (“cross-correction”) X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (ALD) In this X-linked disorder, there is accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids in the brain and adrenal glands arising from their defective metabolism by a peroxisomal, membrane protein encoded by the ABCD1 gene Clinical manifestations in genetically affected boys are highly variable, even within a kindred. The principle role of HCT is to prevent progression of early cerebral ALD, an inflammatory demyelinating disease of childhood that is seen in about 40% of genetically affected individuals HCT does not influence other illness such as adrenal insufficiency or the later myeloneuropathy of the spinal cord
blocks.zh: 【表91.1：IEM 分類】Hurler syndrome（MPSIH）是 iduronidase 缺乏最嚴重的表型，屬溶小體儲積症，因 glycosaminoglycans（heparan、dermatan sulfate）堆積，造成進行性多器官功能異常，包括精神動作發展遲滯、嚴重骨骼疾病、危及生命的心肺併發症及早逝。HCT 可防止早逝並減輕多系統表現，機轉為已植入的供者白血球將缺乏的酵素供應給宿主組織，即 cross-correction。X-linked ALD 則因 ABCD1 所編碼的過氧化體膜蛋白功能異常，使極長鏈脂肪酸在腦與腎上腺堆積。即使同一家族，受影響男孩的臨床表現仍高度多樣。HCT 主要防止早期 cerebral ALD 進展；這是兒童期發炎性脫髓鞘疾病，約見於 40% 基因受影響者。HCT 不會改善腎上腺功能不全或之後的脊髓 myeloneuropathy。

blocks.en: Metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD) This is an autosomal recessive LSD, and there is accumulation of sulfatides, a myelin component, due to deficiency of the arylsulfatase A enzyme. There is demyelination in the central and peripheral nervous systems, and clinical manifestations are related to residual enzyme activity. In the late infantile disease, the commonest and most severe phenotype, there is progressive neurological dysfunction and early death usually by the age of 4 years HCT is ineffective in preventing progression of early presenting disease, although it may have a greater impact on later, attenuated disease especially when applied early in the course of the illness. HSC GT is recently available for presymptomatic late infantile disease, and corrects disease by delivery of supra-physiological enzyme by leukocytes, derived from gene-modified stem cells 91.1.5 Prognostic Index Not available.
blocks.zh: 【表91.1續：Metachromatic leukodystrophy（MLD）】這是體染色體隱性溶小體儲積症，arylsulfatase A 缺乏使髓鞘成分 sulfatides 堆積，造成中樞與周邊神經脫髓鞘；表現與殘餘酵素活性相關。最常見且最嚴重的晚期嬰兒型，會出現進行性神經功能障礙，通常四歲前死亡。HCT 無法有效阻止早發病型進展，但對較晚發、較輕型疾病可能較有效，尤其病程早期介入。近來症狀前的晚期嬰兒型可使用 HSC 基因治療，藉基因修飾幹細胞產生的白血球，提供超生理量酵素以校正疾病。〔91.1.5 預後指標〕目前無可用指標。

blocks.en: 91.1.6 First-Line Treatment (Summary) Multimodality therapies are usual in IEM.
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.6 第一線治療概述〕IEM 通常需多模式治療。

blocks.en: – Residual disease manifestations will require management beyond the HCT episode. This will include orthopaedics, ENT, and speech therapy in lysosomal storage disorders (LSDs), as well as family and educational support.
blocks.zh: 移植之外，殘餘病變仍需照護。例如溶小體儲積症需骨科、耳鼻喉及語言治療，以及家庭和教育支持。

blocks.en: – Pharmacological enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) is used in MPSI but does not correct neurological disease as it does not cross the blood– brain barrier, and alloantibody formation might limit its use in somatic disease. It is used to improve pre-HCT performance, but it has not been shown to influence transplant outcomes.
blocks.zh: MPSI 可使用酵素替代治療（ERT），但因藥物無法穿越血腦障壁，不能校正神經病變；異體抗體形成也可能限制其對全身性病變的效益。ERT 可改善移植前功能狀態，但尚未證實會影響移植結果。

blocks.en: 91.1.7 Second-Line Treatment (Summary) See Sect. 91.1.6., above.
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.7 第二線治療概述〕見上方第91.1.6節。

blocks.en: 91.1.8 Autologous HCT Gene-modified auto-HCT approaches have been shown to improve outcomes in late infantile MLD as the graft delivers more enzyme than possible in a conventional HCT. This treatment has been recently licensed by the EMA for therapy in several European countries.
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.8 自體 HCT〕基因修飾自體 HCT 可比傳統移植提供更多酵素，已顯示能改善晚期嬰兒型 MLD 的結果。按本書撰寫時資訊，這項治療近期已經 EMA 核准，於數個歐洲國家使用。

blocks.en: Similar approaches are under investigation for other lysosomal disorders including MPSIIIA, MPSII, Gaucher (particularly where there is neurological involvement, GD3), and MPSIH. It is likely that this approach will greatly change the landscape of therapeutic approaches in metabolic disease in the coming years.
blocks.zh: MPSIIIA、MPSII、Gaucher disease（尤其神經受累的 GD3）及 MPSIH 等其他溶小體疾病，也在研究相似策略。作者預期，未來數年這會大幅改變代謝疾病的治療。

blocks.en: Similar approaches have been successful in X-ALD. The mechanism of action is different, since there is no supraphysiological production of enzyme. Of course, autologous HCT is also safer. Consecutively, no immune suppression is needed with a lower risk of infections and no risk of GVHD.
blocks.zh: X-ALD 也已有相似策略成功，但機轉不同，並非透過超生理酵素產生。自體 HCT 在這方面亦較安全：後續不需免疫抑制，因此感染風險較低，且沒有 GVHD 風險。

blocks.en: 91.1.9 A llogeneic HCT in MPSIH (Hurler), MLD, and X-ALD (See Table 91.2) Table 91.2 Main characteristics of allo-HCT for MPSIH (Hurler), MLD, and X-ALD Indicated in MPSIH (Hurler) is a standard indication for HCT In MLD, HCT is usually reserved for later (attenuated) forms of the disease, namely, juvenile and adult forms (note HCT GT is licensed and standard of care in the more severe forms of disease, manifesting earlier) In X-ALD, HCT is indicated in early cerebral inflammatory disease. Ordinarily, a genetically affected individual has serial (6 monthly or annual) MRI scans from early childhood, and HCT is carried out when there are early MRI changes of demyelination (the MRI changes are scored as a Loes score) Contraindications Where MPSIH is diagnosed late, the opportunity for HCT to meaningfully alter the natural history of the disease might be lost. No predetermined and simple rules can be applied. HCT is usually not offered to a child presenting beyond the age of 30 months, but careful multidisciplinary assessment is required. Not transplanting means the child will die of somatic disease manifestations, and the decision not to transplant is not easy to make Late infantile MLD is not usually considered for allogeneic HCT. Note that such disease—if diagnosed in a timely fashion—has been shown to be markedly improved using an autologous, ex vivo HSC gene therapy approach
blocks.zh: 〔91.1.9 MPSIH、MLD 與 X-ALD 的異體 HCT；表91.2〕【適應症】MPSIH 是標準移植適應症。MLD 的 allo-HCT 通常保留於較晚發、較輕的青少年型及成人型；較早發的嚴重病型，目前已有獲准且屬標準照護的幹細胞基因治療。X-ALD 則在早期腦部發炎時移植：通常從幼年起，每半年或一年以 MRI 追蹤，出現早期脫髓鞘變化即安排 HCT；MRI 變化可用 Loes score 評分。【禁忌／限制】MPSIH 若太晚診斷，可能已錯失改變自然病程的機會。沒有能一概適用的簡單規則；通常不對超過 30 個月才就醫者提供 HCT，但須仔細跨專科評估。未移植可能因身體病變而死亡，因此不移植的決定並不容易。晚期嬰兒型 MLD 通常不採 allo-HCT，但及時診斷者使用自體、體外 HSC 基因治療，可明顯改善病情。

blocks.en: Advanced cerebral X-ALD is considered a contraindication for HCT. Disease will progress through transplant. The MRI scan-derived Loes score might predict those who will benefit most from HCT Donor In LSD, non-carrier MFD > MUD > carrier MFD In LSD, UCB is frequently preferred to BM, since the post-HCT chimerism is higher in such recipients, and the interval between referral and HCT is likely shortest (primary rejection might be higher using UCB) PB is rarely used as a donor cell source In X-ALD, MFD > MUD Haplo-HCT is rarely indicated in IEM Conditioning: standard Engraftment is difficult in IEM. Generally reduced intensity conditioning and ex vivo TCD are associated with high rates of graft loss MSD/MFD: IV BU (MAC AUC)/FLU (160 mg/m²) MUD: IV BU (MAC AUC)/FLU (160 mg/m²) AUTO (HCT GT): IV BU (MAC AUC). No immune suppression is necessary Conditioning: reduced toxicity Occasionally reduced toxicity conditioning might be employed In somatic IEM, such as Wolman or attenuated MPS: TREO (42 g/m²)/FLU (160 mg/m²)/TT (10 mg/kg) Source of SC UCB often preferred in LSD (higher chimerism, and better enzyme delivery therefore) BM rather than PB in MUD donors
blocks.zh: 【表91.2續】晚期 cerebral X-ALD 被視為 HCT 禁忌，因疾病可能在移植過程仍持續進展；Loes score 有助辨識最可能獲益者。【供者】溶小體儲積症（LSD）：非帶因 MFD > MUD > 帶因 MFD。LSD 常偏好臍帶血而非骨髓，因嵌合較高、轉介至移植時間可能最短，但初次排斥可能較多。PB 很少作為來源。X-ALD：MFD > MUD。IEM 很少使用 haplo-HCT。【標準前處理】IEM 植入較困難；一般 RIC 與體外 TCD 與較高移植物流失相關。MSD／MFD 及 MUD：IV BU（劑量達 MAC AUC）＋FLU 160 mg/m²。自體基因治療：IV BU（MAC AUC），不需免疫抑制。【減毒前處理】偶爾可用於 Wolman 或較輕型 MPS 等全身性 IEM：TREO 42 g/m²＋FLU 160 mg/m²＋TT 10 mg/kg。【細胞來源】LSD 常偏好 UCB，因較高嵌合可帶來較佳酵素供應；MUD 偏好 BM 而非 PB。

blocks.en: No ex vivo TCD as this is shown to contribute to graft loss GvHD prophylaxis MSD/MFD: ATG/Campath, CSA + MMF MUD: ATG/Campath, CSA + MMF Unleated CB: Proximal ATG (−9 to −6), CSA + MMF or CSA + PRD (note rituximab is often added to the preparative regimen in CB transplant to reduce post-transplant autoimmune cytopenia and to reduce primary graft rejection) TRM in MPSIH OS in MPSIH MSD: <5% MUD: <10% Engrafted survival of >80% and Overall survival of 90% MAC AUC doses adjusted to achieve MAC AUC, MSD match sibling donor, MFD match family donor, MUD much unrelated donor, LSD lysosomal storage disorder, EIM inborn errors of metabolism
blocks.zh: 【表91.2續】不使用體外 TCD，因其會增加移植物流失。【GVHD 預防】MSD／MFD：ATG／Campath、CSA＋MMF；MUD：ATG／Campath、CSA＋MMF；非親屬 CB：ATG 於第 −9 至 −6 天，搭配 CSA＋MMF 或 CSA＋PRD。CB 前處理常另加 rituximab，以降低移植後自體免疫性血球低下及初次移植物排斥。【MPSIH 的結果】TRM：MSD <5%，MUD <10%；成功植入且存活比例 >80%，整體存活率約 90%。縮寫：MAC AUC＝調整劑量以達骨髓消除性 AUC；MSD＝相合同胞供者；MFD＝相合家庭供者；MUD＝相合非親屬供者；LSD＝溶小體儲積症；IEM＝先天代謝疾病。

blocks.en: 91.2 Osteopetrosis 91.2.1 Definition and Epidemiology Osteopetrosis (OP) is a generic name for a variety of rare monogenetic diseases characterized by sclerosis of the skeleton. At least nine variants are known with different modes of inheritance and severity, which cumulatively have an incidence ~1:100,000. The disease originates from reduced or complete lack of osteoclast function and, as a consequence, impairment of bone resorption.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2 骨硬化症；91.2.1 定義與流行病學〕Osteopetrosis（OP）是多種以骨骼硬化為特徵的罕見單基因疾病總稱。已知至少九種變異類型，遺傳方式及嚴重度不同，合計發生率約 1／100,000。疾病源於破骨細胞功能下降或完全缺失，因而無法正常骨吸收。

blocks.en: 91.2.2 Diagnosis In addition to the obligate increased bone density of all bones (X-ray), a combination of symptoms can be found in classical infantile osteopetrosis after birth. These symptoms include characteristic changes of the head (macrocephalus, frontal bossing, choanal stenosis), vision impairment (due to narrowed foramina), hematological insufficiency (thrombocytopenia, anemia, leukocytosis), hepatosplenomegaly (due to extramedullar hematopoiesis), and hypocalcemia (with second-ary hyperparathyroidism). Cave: OP is a genetical and phenotypical heterogenous disease with atypical presentations (incomplete and/or delayed onset of symptoms). In these cases, an intensive work-up including spine biopsy and cranial MRI is recommended.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.2 診斷〕除 X 光必然可見全身骨密度增加外，典型嬰兒型 OP 出生後可合併頭部特徵（大頭、前額突出、後鼻孔狹窄）、因孔道變窄造成視力障礙、造血不足（血小板低下、貧血、白血球增加）、因髓外造血造成肝脾腫大，以及低血鈣伴續發性副甲狀腺機能亢進。須注意，OP 在遺傳及表型上高度異質，可能有症狀不完整或較晚出現的非典型表現；這些病例建議深入檢查，包括原文所述 spine biopsy 與顱部 MRI。
blocks.note: 原書文字為「spine biopsy」，此處保留該用語，未擅自替換為其他檢查；請與疾病專科評估及原指引核對。

blocks.en: 91.2.3 Classification Osteopetrosis Infantile “malignant” autosomal recessive OP (ARO) Clinical symptoms in infancy, death without HCT usually in the first decade of life, biallelic mutations in TCIRG1, CLCN7, SNX10, TNFRSF11A/RANK, and FERMT3/ KINDLIN-3; HCT indicated, if excluded: – “Neurodegenerative OP” (all OSTM1 and about half of CLCN7 cases) – “Extrinsic osteoclast defects” (TNFSF11/RANKL cases) Osteopetrosis Intermediate osteopetrosis Clinical symptoms in the first decade, HCT may be indicated in severe forms with hematological insufficiency and (imminent) visual impairment after individual assessment Specific from: CA2 deficiency (renal tubular acidosis with cerebral calcifications): HCT may be considered after individual assessment in cases with hematological insufficiency and (imminent) visual impairment if neurological and renal problems are controlled Benign osteopetrosis (ADO) M. Albers Schoenberg (monoallelic CLCN7 mutations): HCT usually not indicated; HCT may be considered after individual assessment in clinical severe cases 91.2.4 Risk Factors There is an increased risk of pulmonary hypertension (pre and post HCT) and SOS/VOD (post BMT). The risk of non-engraftment and rejection increases with severity of disease and age.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.3 分類〕【嬰兒型「惡性」體染色體隱性 OP（ARO）】嬰兒期發病，未 HCT 通常十歲前死亡；可有 TCIRG1、CLCN7、SNX10、TNFRSF11A／RANK、FERMT3／KINDLIN-3 的雙等位基因變異。排除「神經退化型 OP」（所有 OSTM1，以及約半數 CLCN7 病例）與「破骨細胞外在缺陷」（TNFSF11／RANKL）後，可評估 HCT。【中間型 OP】十歲內出現症狀；若有造血不足及已出現或迫近的視力損害，可個別評估移植。特殊的 CA2 缺乏會造成腎小管酸中毒與腦鈣化；若造血不足、視力受威脅，且神經及腎臟問題已控制，可考慮 HCT。【良性體染色體顯性 OP（ADO）】Albers–Schönberg disease，為 CLCN7 單等位基因變異，通常不需 HCT；極嚴重者仍可個別評估。〔91.2.4 風險因子〕患者在 HCT 前後的肺高壓，以及移植後 SOS／VOD 風險較高；疾病越嚴重、年齡越大，未植入與排斥風險越高。

blocks.en: 91.2.5 Prognostic Index Not available.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.5 預後指標〕目前無可用指標。

blocks.en: 91.2.6 First-Line Treatment (Summary) Symptomatic, steroids may be beneficial to improve hematological symptoms.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.6 第一線治療概述〕以症狀治療為主；steroids 可能改善血液學症狀。

blocks.en: 91.2.7 Second-Line Treatment (Summary) Not available.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.7 第二線治療概述〕目前無可用治療。

blocks.en: 91.2.8 Autologous HCT Clinical trials for gene-modified auto-HCT for TCIRG1 defects in preparation.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.8 自體 HCT〕本書撰寫時，針對 TCIRG1 缺陷的基因修飾自體 HCT 臨床試驗正在準備中。

blocks.en: 91.2.9 A llogeneic HCT (See Table 91.3)  Further Reading: original-language references follow.
blocks.zh: 〔91.2.9 異體 HCT〕詳見表91.3。其後為延伸閱讀書目，保留英文。

blocks.en: Table 91 .3 Main characteristics of allo-HCT for osteopetrosis Indicated in Infantile osteopetrosis: clinical symptoms and exclusion of neurodegenerative and extrinsic osteoclast defect Contraindications Neurodegenerative osteopetrosis: symptoms (non-hypocalcemic convulsions/EEC changes, severe progredient developmental delay) and/or biallelic mutations in OSTM1 and CLCN7; cave: only about half of CLCN7 mutations cause neurodegeneration Osteopetrosis not intrinsic to defects in differentiation or function in osteoclasts: TNFSF11/ RANKL Donor MFD > MUD > haplo (cord blood not recommended) Conditioning: standard MSD/MFD: IV BU (MAC AUC)/ FLU (160 mg/m²) MUD: IV BU (MAC AUC)/FLU (160 mg/m²) Haplo: IV BU (MAC AUC)/FLU (160 mg/m²) Conditioning: reduced toxicity MSD/MFD: TREO/FLU (150 mg/ m2)/TT (8–10 mg/kg) MUD: TREO/FLU (150 mg/m²)/ TT (8–10 mg/kg) Conditioning: post cy protocol In patients with MMUD or haplo donors, an adapted PT-CY protocol should be used (see ESID guidelines. Lankester et al. 2021) Source of SC Matched donors, PT-CY protocol: T replete BM > PB GvHD prophylaxis MSD/MFD: CSA + MMF (consider ATG or Campath in MFD) MUD: CSA + MMF + ATG (or Campath) Haplo—T replete: Campath, PT-CY , TAC (or CSA) + MMF TRM MSD/MUD: 10–20%
blocks.zh: 【表91.3：OP 異體 HCT 主要特徵】適應症：有臨床症狀的嬰兒型 OP，須排除神經退化與破骨細胞外在缺陷。禁忌：具非低血鈣性癲癇／原文所稱 EEC 變化、嚴重進行性發展遲緩，及／或 OSTM1、CLCN7 雙等位基因變異的神經退化型 OP；但僅約半數 CLCN7 變異造成神經退化。TNFSF11／RANKL 病變並非破骨細胞分化／功能的內在缺陷，也不適合此療法。供者：MFD > MUD > haplo，不建議 CB。標準前處理：MSD／MFD、MUD、haplo 皆為 IV BU（MAC AUC）＋FLU 160 mg/m²。減毒前處理：MSD／MFD 或 MUD 可用 TREO／FLU 150 mg/m²／TT 8–10 mg/kg。MMUD 或 haplo 應採調整過的 PT-CY 方案（見 ESID 指引，Lankester 等，2021）。細胞來源：相合供者、PT-CY 平台偏好 T-replete BM > PB。GVHD 預防：MSD／MFD 用 CSA＋MMF，MFD 可考慮 ATG 或 Campath；MUD 用 CSA＋MMF＋ATG（或 Campath）；T-replete haplo 用 Campath、PT-CY、TAC（或 CSA）＋MMF。TRM：MSD／MUD 10–20%。
blocks.note: 表中原文寫「EEC changes」，可能為 EEG 的排印問題；譯文保留原文用語。神經退化與 RANKL 缺陷的移植禁忌必須依基因及專科評估判定。

blocks.en: Haplo: ~20–30% OS MSD: ~90% MUD: ~80% Haplo/MMUD: ~70% MAC AUC doses adjusted to achieve MAC AUC, MSD match sibling donor, MFD match family donor, MUD much unrelated donor, MMUD mismatch unrelated donor
blocks.zh: 【表91.3續】Haplo 的 TRM 約 20–30%。整體存活率：MSD 約 90%，MUD 約 80%，haplo／MMUD 約 70%。MAC AUC 為調整劑量以達骨髓消除性 AUC；MSD 為相合同胞、MFD 為相合家庭、MUD 為相合非親屬、MMUD 為不相合非親屬供者。
